description:
Choose to execute the following three branch tasks:

Task 1: Check if it is located at position A or check if it is located at position B, then check if the hand is empty, and finally pick up the object in front of you.

Task 2: Check if it is located at position C, and then execute task A.

Task 3: Check if it is located in the kitchen and then locate the bottle.
bt_pretty: selector(sequence(selector(atPosA, atPosB), empty, pickUp), sequence(atPosC, doTaskA), sequence(atKitchen, locateBottle))

description:
Selectively execute the following four branch tasks:

Task 1: Check if you are at location A or have navigated to location A.

Task 2: Check if you are at location B or have navigated to location B.

Task 3: Check if you are at location C or have navigated to location C.

Task 4: Check if it is at position 3 or navigate to position 3.
bt_pretty: selector(selector(atPosA, goToPosA), selector(atPosB, goToPosB), selector(atPosC, goToPosC), selector(atPos3, goToPos3))

description:
Execute the following three tasks in sequence:

Task 1: Execute Task A or Task B.

Task 2: Move to the kitchen

Task 3: Check if you are currently holding a knife, and then execute Task C.
bt_pretty: sequence(selector(doTaskA, doTaskB), goToKitchen, sequence(holdKnife, doTaskC))

description:
The robot chooses to perform the following two branch tasks:

Task 1: If the current robot is in a low battery state, turn off the gripper, navigate to the charging station location, and start charging.Task 2: Sequential execution of sub tasks: Subtask 1: The robot move to position A and execute task A, move to position B and execute task B, and move to position C and execute task C. Subtask 2: Check if there is any input information or wait for input. Subtask 3: Check if the inv is valid or calculate the inv value. Finally, the robot searches for the target object and then activates the manipulator.

description: Execute the following tasks in sequence: Accept the destination location point, and then move the operating finger towards the target location.

description:

Task 1: The alarm is sounding, check if Task A has been completed.

description:
Execute the following tasks in sequence:
Task 1: First navigate to location A, then pick up the item.
Task 2: Choose to execute the following branch tasks:
Subtask 1: When the alarm sounds, navigate to location B and place the item at location B.
Subtask 2: Navigate to location C and place the item at location C.

description: When the alarm sounds, first navigate to location A and pick up the item on the ground. Otherwise, first navigate to location B and put down the item in your hand.

description:
There are two tasks to choose from:
Task 1: Check if the alarm sounds, select to execute the following two subtasks: Subtask 1.1: Check if Task A has been completed. Subtask 1.2: Check if it is located at position A, if not, navigate to position A, and then, execute task A.
Task 2: Choose to execute the following two subtasks: Subtask 2.1: Check if Task B has been completed. Subtask 2.2: Check if it is located at position B ,if not, navigate to position B, and then, execute task B.

description:
Robots can choose to perform the following two branch tasks:

Task 1: Firstly, acquire the target, and then move to the target location, then check if the target is nearby, and finally attack the target.

Task 2: Follow humans to move.

description:
Execute the following tasks in sequence:

Task 1: Check if it is located at position A, and then complete task A.

Task 2: Obtain the target and then move to the destination.

Task 3: Check if the target is nearby and then attack the target.

Task 4: Finally check if Task A has been completed.

description:

description: Firstly, check if the battery level of the robot is in a low state. Then perform one of the following tasks: either the robot is already in the charging station position, or the robot navigates to the charging station position. Finally, charge it.

description: Choose to execute the following branch task: Task 1: Check if the robot's battery is fully charged, then check if it is charging, and then stop charging. Task 2: Check if the battery level is not sufficient, then  connect it to the charging station, and then go charge it. Task 3: seek help from humans, move to the charging station location, and then wait for charging.

description:
Robots have the following four branch tasks:

Task 1: Navigate to position A and pick up the items in front of you. Then check if the battery level is sufficient, and execute task A.

Task 2: Check if the current position is A, and then check if the current hand is empty. Then pick up the object in front of you. Then navigate to position B and put down the object in your hand. Finally, navigate to location C and execute task C.

Task 3: Check if the battery is low, navigate to the charging station location, and start charging. Then check if the robot is hungry and eat food.

Task 4: Follow human movement.

description:
Three selectable execution tasks:
Task 1: Check if there are any victims present and rescue them.
Task 2:  If there is still a fire source in the room, use a fire extinguisher to extinguish the fire. 
Task 3: Transfer to another room and then continue rescue.
﻿

description:
You can choose to seek help from humans or perform the following tasks:

Execute the following two subtasks in the order of tasks:

Subtask 1: Follow human movement. Or check if the room number is known and then check if the robot is in the room or navigating to the room.

Subtask 2: Execute the following two subtasks in sequence: Subtask 1: Check if the bottle has been found or search for the bottle. Subtask 2: Check if the bottle has been grabbed, or perform task A, or perform the following sequence of tasks: either inv has already been calculated and is a valid value, or calculate the value of Inv. Then, check if the bottle is located or positioned, and grab the bottle.

description:
The robot executes the following tasks in sequence:
Task 1: Firstly, the robot receives input data and sets the parameters to the values of this data.
Task 2: Choose to execute the following two subtasks:
Subtask 1: Execute the following three tasks in sequence: Task 1: Check the battery status. If the battery status is good, search for the target object. Task 2:  If the target object has been found, open the gripper, pick the object, and finally close the gripper.  Task 3: If the target has already been captured, move to the target room, and finally put down the object.
Subtask 2: If the battery is low, move it to a charging station for charging.

description:
Perform the following tasks in sequence:

Task 1: First, the robot receives input data and sets the parameters to the values ​​corresponding to that data. Then, it compares the current parameter values ​​with the preset values.

Task 2: If the values ​​are equal, stop the search. Otherwise, search for the target.

Task 3: Pick up the target and move it to the kitchen, then place it down. Alternatively, move it to location A and complete Task A.
